Ava (CSM): Quick heads-up — prepping QBR for the NovaHealth cohort (embed-heavy). Need a 90-day token micro-forecast + recommended guardrail thresholds by EOD tomorrow. Primary asks:
1) forecast peak daily tokens
2) suggested auto-throttle thresholds (soft/hard)
3) one-line commit recommendation (monthly credits vs overage)
Also want enablement plan + feedback-capture checklist for their CS team. @Diego @Priya :eyes:

Diego (FinOps): Got it. Quick q — do we use the current embed-per-call avg = 350 tokens or the adjusted 420 after the encoder patch? Uploading last 90d export now: s3://redwood-exports/novaw/usage_90d.csv

Diego (FinOps): SQL I ran for baseline:
```sql
SELECT date, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM usage
WHERE account_id = 'novaw'
  AND date >= current_date - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 90;
```

Priya (CS Ops): Recommend a short enablement combo: 30–45m webinar + 1-pager + interactive dashboard walkthrough. Feedback capture: 6-question survey + 3 sample prompt captures. I can own artifacts and attendee invites. ETA tomorrow 12:00pm PST.

Liam (Solutions Eng): Guardrail sketch — propose soft throttle at 75% of the 95th percentile daily, hard throttle at 110% of reserved commit. Example rule (ops-friendly):
```text
if rolling7d_avg(tokens) > 0.75 * p95_daily_tokens:
    reduce_batch_size(20%)
if rolling1d(tokens) > 1.10 * reserved_commit_daily:
    apply_hard_throttle()  # block new heavy jobs, notify CS + customer
```
Keep fallback model to smaller quantized variant when throttled.

OnboardingBot: Automated alert — account novaw crossed soft threshold yesterday (triggered throttles: 2 events). See incident #INC-2023-9987.

Ava (CSM): Good context. Diego — can you drop the numeric forecast + a one-line commit rec (credits vs overage)? Priya — attach enablement artifacts to the QBR deck. Liam — paste the pseudocode into the ops runbook section.

Diego (FinOps): Quick numbers (using adjusted 420 tokens/call):
- 90-day projected total tokens: 18,450,000
- Peak daily tokens (projected): 1,120,000
- 95th percentile daily (observed): 980,000
One-line commit rec: recommend a conservative monthly reserved credit equal to 1.1x median monthly usage (or buy a small monthly commit + overage at lower rate). :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Priya (CS Ops): Enablement checklist (I will own):
1) Invite stakeholders (AMs, Infra, ML lead)
2) Run 45m workshop with dashboard walkthrough
3) Send 6-question survey post-webinar
4) Collect 3 sample prompts + outputs for eval
5) Schedule follow-up 2 weeks later
Artifacts: drive.link/novaw-enablement (will upload by noon)

Liam (Solutions Eng): Pseudocode for runbook (short):
```python
def guardrail_check(usage_window):
    p95 = compute_p95(usage_window)
    rolling7 = rolling_avg(usage_window, 7)
    if rolling7 > 0.75 * p95:
        apply_soft_throttle()
    if latest_day(usage_window) > 1.10 * reserved_daily:
        apply_hard_throttle(); notify_cs_team()
```
Include metric names and alert links in runbook.

Ava (CSM): Perfect — I'll synthesize into the QBR deck. Tagging renewal risk: MEDIUM due to spend volatility and recent encoder change. Next sync: 10:00 AM PST tomorrow to finalize slides. :calendar:
